title: Mixtape and Group Chat
author: Lior Voss
blurb: Cyrus Eriksen, a debate champion who can't win the argument at home, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. But when a best friend goes missing, leaving only a set of keys behind, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must save the tradition that made the town before prom.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
